title: Smoothness of the explicit prepared Popescu quotient
statement: Let R be Noetherian [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring], pi in R with Ann_R(pi)=Ann_R(pi^2), and Cbar an R/pi^2R-algebra compatible with its R-algebra structure. Let d be prepared finite polynomial data as in [lem-weil-pbc-popescu-lift-preparation]. Define Q=R[x,z], p_{kl}=a_k z_l-sum_{j in E_k}h_{klj}z_j-pi g_{kl}, J=(f_l-pi z_l,p_{kl}), and D=ULift(Q/J). Let c:Cbar to D/pi D be an R-algebra map taking epsilon(X_i) to the class of the original generator x_i. Let cmod:Cbar/pi Cbar to D/pi D have composite with the quotient projection equal to c. Then R to D is smooth at every prime avoiding pi. For every prime q of D/pi D whose inverse image under c is smooth over R/pi^2R [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal], R to D is smooth at the inverse-image prime of D, and Cbar/pi Cbar to D/pi D is smooth at q for the algebra structure induced by cmod. This concerns only the explicit constructed D, not arbitrary algebras.

source.place: Proof of Lemma 07CP, original DAG steps 8--18, key equality and comparison with D_k (Tag 07CP; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/07CP)

proof.text: Use the Prepared hypotheses for the finite smooth-locus cover, free conormal and differential bases, normalized coefficients and cleared relations. These hypotheses are about the presented reduced quotient, identified with Cbar by the surjective epsilon and its specified kernel. The map c has the original generator values and cmod is its specified quotient factor.

(Key equality.) For all $k,\ell$, in $Q$: $\pi p_{k,\ell}=\pi a_kz_\ell-\sum_{j\in E_k}\pi h^j_{k,\ell}z_j-\pi^2g_{k,\ell}=-a_k(f_\ell-\pi z_\ell)+\sum_{j\in E_k}h^j_{k,\ell}(f_j-\pi z_j)$, by substituting $\pi^2g_{k,\ell}=a_kf_\ell-\sum_jh^j_{k,\ell}f_j$ from (4).

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma 07CP (lemma-lifting), lines 1534-1546 (the key equality)

proof.text: (Property (b).) Invert $\pi$. By Step 8 every $p_{k,\ell}$ lies in the ideal of $Q_\pi$ generated by the $f_j-\pi z_j=-\pi(z_j-\pi^{-1}f_j)$, so $D_\pi=Q_\pi/(z_j-\pi^{-1}f_j,\ 1\le j\le m)\cong P_\pi=R_\pi[x_1,\dots,x_n]$ as $R$-algebras ($z_j\mapsto\pi^{-1}f_j$). $R\to P$ is smooth [lem-weil-pbc-polynomial-ring-smooth], hence $R\to P_\pi$ is smooth [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map-principal-localization] [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map], so $D_\pi$ is a smooth $R$-algebra. For a prime $\mathfrak q\subset D$ with $\pi\notin\mathfrak q$ the element $g=\pi\notin\mathfrak q$ shows that $R\to D$ is smooth at $\mathfrak q$ [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal]: (b).

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma 07CP (lemma-lifting), lines 1547-1551 ('D[1/pi] is isomorphic to R[1/pi][x_1..x_n,z_1..z_m]/(f_j - pi z_j) which is isomorphic to R[1/pi][x_1..x_n] hence smooth over R. This proves (b).')

proof.text:
(The rings $D_k$.) Fix $k$ and let $D_k=Q/(f_j-\pi z_j\ (j\in E_k),\ p_{k,\ell}\ (\ell
otin E_k))$: $n+m$ variables and $|E_k|+(m-|E_k|)=m$ relations (the $p_{k,\ell}$ with $\ell\in E_k$ are $0$). The relations of $D_k$ are among those of $D$, so $D=D_k/J_k$ where $J_k\subseteq D_k$ is the ideal generated by the images of $f_\ell-\pi z_\ell$ ($\ell
otin E_k$) and of $p_{k',\ell}$ ($k'
e k$, all $\ell$), a finitely generated ideal.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma 07CP (lemma-lifting), lines 1553-1559 (definition of D_k and the count of equations)

proof.text: (The ring $(D_k/\pi D_k)_{a_k}$.) Write $\tilde f$ for the image of $f$ in $(R/\pi R)[x,z]$. By (4) modulo $\pi$, $a_k\tilde f_\ell\in(\tilde f_j,\ j\in E_k)$ for all $\ell$, so in $(R/\pi R)[x]_{a_k}$ the ideals $(\tilde f_j,\ j\in E_k)$ and $(\tilde f_1,\dots,\tilde f_m)$ agree and $(R/\pi R)[x]_{a_k}/(\tilde f_j,\ j\in E_k)=(\bar C/\pi\bar C)_{a_k}$ (as $\bar C/\pi\bar C=(R/\pi R)[x]/(\tilde f_1,\dots,\tilde f_m)$). Hence $(D_k/\pi D_k)_{a_k}=(\bar C/\pi\bar C)_{a_k}[z_1,\dots,z_m]/(a_kz_\ell-\sum_{j\in E_k}h^j_{k,\ell}z_j,\ \ell\notin E_k)\cong(\bar C/\pi\bar C)_{a_k}[z_j,\ j\in E_k]$, solving for $z_\ell=a_k^{-1}\sum_jh^j_{k,\ell}z_j$ ($a_k$ is a unit). This is an isomorphism of $\bar C/\pi\bar C$-algebras for the map $\bar C/\pi\bar C\to(D_k/\pi D_k)_{a_k}$, $x_i\mapsto x_i$, which is well defined by the same computation and is compatible with $\rho$ (Step 7) under $D_k\to D$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma 07CP (lemma-lifting), lines 1559-1570 (computation of (D_k/pi D_k)_{a_k})

proof.text: (Smoothness modulo $\pi$.) By (2'), $(\bar C/\pi\bar C)_{a_k}\cong(R/\pi R)\otimes_{R/\pi^2R}\bar C_{\bar a_k}$ is smooth over $R/\pi R$ [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map-base-change-composition] (1), with $\Omega_{(\bar C/\pi\bar C)_{a_k}/(R/\pi R)}$ free of rank $n-|E_k|$ [lem-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials-base-change]. By Step 11, $(D_k/\pi D_k)_{a_k}$ is a polynomial ring in $|E_k|$ variables over it, hence smooth over it [lem-weil-pbc-polynomial-ring-smooth], hence smooth over $R/\pi R$ (composition (2)), and $\Omega_{(D_k/\pi D_k)_{a_k}/(R/\pi R)}$ is free of rank $(n-|E_k|)+|E_k|=n$ [lem-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials-polynomial-extension]. Moreover $\bar C/\pi\bar C\to(\bar C/\pi\bar C)_{a_k}$ is smooth (the identity of $\bar C/\pi\bar C$ is smooth, a polynomial ring in $0$ variables, and [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map-principal-localization]), so $\bar C/\pi\bar C\to(D_k/\pi D_k)_{a_k}$ is smooth (composition), i.e. $\bar C/\pi\bar C\to D_k/\pi D_k$ is smooth at every prime not containing $a_k$ [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal] [def-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map].

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma 07CP (lemma-lifting), lines 1570-1573 ('In particular (D_k/pi D_k)_{a_k} is smooth over (C-bar/pi C-bar)_{a_k}. By our choice of a_k we have that (C-bar/pi C-bar)_{a_k} is smooth over R/pi R of relative dimension n - |E_k|, see (2).')

proof.text: (The fibre of $R\to D_k$ at $\mathfrak q_k$ is smooth of dimension $n$.) Let $\mathfrak q_k\subset D_k$ be a prime with $\pi\in\mathfrak q_k$ and $a_k\notin\mathfrak q_k$, $\mathfrak p=\mathfrak q_k\cap R$ (so $\pi\in\mathfrak p$), $F=D_k\otimes_R\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ the fibre ring [def-weil-pbc-localization-at-prime] and $\mathfrak Q_k\subset F$ the kernel of $F\to\kappa(\mathfrak q_k)$. As $\pi\mapsto0$ in $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$, $F\cong(D_k/\pi D_k)\otimes_{R/\pi R}\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ and $F_{a_k}\cong(D_k/\pi D_k)_{a_k}\otimes_{R/\pi R}\kappa(\mathfrak p)$; by Step 12 it is smooth over $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$ [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map-base-change-composition] with $\Omega_{F_{a_k}/\kappa(\mathfrak p)}$ free of rank $n$ [lem-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials-base-change]. Since $a_k$ maps to a unit of $\kappa(\mathfrak q_k)$, $a_k\notin\mathfrak Q_k$, so $\kappa(\mathfrak p)\to F$ is smooth at $\mathfrak Q_k$ [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal], $F$ is finitely generated over $\kappa(\mathfrak p)$, and $\Omega_{F/\kappa(\mathfrak p)}\otimes_F\kappa(\mathfrak Q_k)\cong\Omega_{F_{a_k}/\kappa(\mathfrak p)}\otimes\kappa(\mathfrak Q_k)$ [lem-weil-pbc-kahler-differentials-localization] has dimension $n$. By [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-over-field-dimension-differentials] the dimension of $\operatorname{Spec}F$ at $\mathfrak Q_k$ is $n$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma 07CP (lemma-lifting), lines 1573-1576 ('Hence for a prime q_k of D_k containing pi and lying over Spec(C-bar_{a_k}) the fibre ring of R -> D_k is smooth at q_k of dimension n')

proof.text: ($R\to D_k$ is smooth at $\mathfrak q_k$.) For $\mathfrak q_k$ as in Step 13: $D_k$ is $R[n+m\text{ variables}]$ modulo $m$ relations (Step 10) and the fibre has dimension $n=(n+m)-m$ at $\mathfrak Q_k$, so by [lem-weil-pbc-equation-count-fibre-dimension-flat] the local ring map $R_{\mathfrak p}\to(D_k)_{\mathfrak q_k}$ is flat ('syntomic at $\mathfrak q_k$'). $D_k$ is of finite presentation over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-finitely-presented-algebra] and $\kappa(\mathfrak p)\to F$ is smooth at $\mathfrak Q_k$ (Step 13), so by [lem-weil-pbc-flat-smooth-fibre-smooth-at-prime] $R\to D_k$ is smooth at $\mathfrak q_k$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma 07CP (lemma-lifting), lines 1576-1581 ('Thus R -> D_k is syntomic at q_k by our count of the number of equations above, see Algebra, Lemma 00ST. Hence R -> D_k is smooth at q_k, see Algebra, Lemma 00TF.')

proof.text: (The relations $f_\ell-\pi z_\ell$ vanish on $D(a_k)$.) In $D_k$ we have $p_{k,\ell}=0$ and $f_j-\pi z_j=0$ for $j\in E_k$, so the key equality (Step 8) gives $a_k(f_\ell-\pi z_\ell)=0$ in $D_k$; as $a_k$ is a unit in $(D_k)_{a_k}$, $f_\ell-\pi z_\ell=0$ in $(D_k)_{a_k}$ for every $\ell$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma 07CP (lemma-lifting), lines 1592-1597

proof.text: (The $p_{k',\ell}$ lie in $\pi(D_k)_{a_k}$.) Let $k',\ell$ be given and $c_j=a_{k'}h^j_{k,\ell}-\sum_{j'\in E_{k'}}h^{j'}_{k',\ell}h^j_{k,j'}\in P$ for $j\in E_k$. In the $\bar C$-module $\bar I/\bar I^2$, (4) gives $a_k\bar f_\ell=\sum_{j\in E_k}h^j_{k,\ell}\bar f_j$ (and likewise for $k'$); computing $a_{k'}a_k\bar f_\ell$ once as $a_{k'}\sum_{j\in E_k}h^j_{k,\ell}\bar f_j$ and once as $a_k\sum_{j'\in E_{k'}}h^{j'}_{k',\ell}\bar f_{j'}=\sum_{j'\in E_{k'}}h^{j'}_{k',\ell}\sum_{j\in E_k}h^j_{k,j'}\bar f_j$ gives $\sum_{j\in E_k}c_j\bar f_j=0$ in $\bar I/\bar I^2$. By (2) every $c_j$ is $0$ in $\bar C_{\bar a_k}$, i.e. $a_k^{N_1}c_j\in I+\pi^2P$; by (3) and finite generation of $\bar I$, $a_k^{N_2}I\subseteq I_{E_k}+\pi^2P$; so $a_k^Nc_j\in I_{E_k}+\pi^2P$ with $N=N_1+N_2$ [def-weil-pbc-module-localization-away]. Expanding the definitions, $a_kp_{k',\ell}-a_{k'}p_{k,\ell}+\sum_{j'\in E_{k'}}h^{j'}_{k',\ell}p_{k,j'}\equiv\sum_{j\in E_k}c_jz_j\pmod{\pi Q}$ (the terms $a_ka_{k'}z_\ell$ and $a_kh^{j'}_{k',\ell}z_{j'}$ cancel). Multiplying by $a_k^N$: $a_k^{N+1}p_{k',\ell}$ lies in the ideal of $Q$ generated by $I_{E_k}$, $\pi$ and the $p_{k,\cdot}$. In $(D_k)_{a_k}$ the $p_{k,\cdot}$ vanish and $f_j=\pi z_j$ for $j\in E_k$, so $I_{E_k}\subseteq\pi(D_k)_{a_k}$; as $a_k$ is a unit, $p_{k',\ell}\in\pi(D_k)_{a_k}$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma 07CP (lemma-lifting), lines 1597-1630 (the Einstein-summation computation; Stacks' '(I-bar_k/I-bar_k^2)_{a_k} is free' is (2) for I-bar/I-bar^2)

proof.text: (The kernel $J_k$ vanishes at $\mathfrak q_k$.) Let $\mathfrak q_k$ be as in Step 13. By the key equality for $k'$, $\pi p_{k',\ell}=-a_{k'}(f_\ell-\pi z_\ell)+\sum_{j'\in E_{k'}}h^{j'}_{k',\ell}(f_{j'}-\pi z_{j'})$, which is $0$ in $(D_k)_{a_k}$ by Step 15. With Step 16, $p_{k',\ell}=\pi y$ with $y\in(D_k)_{a_k}$ and $\pi^2y=0$. Pass to $(D_k)_{\mathfrak q_k}$, a localization of $(D_k)_{a_k}$. By Step 14 there is $g\notin\mathfrak q_k$ with $(D_k)_g$ smooth over $R$ [def-weil-pbc-singular-ideal], hence flat [lem-weil-pbc-smooth-ring-map-flat]; $(D_k)_{\mathfrak q_k}$ is a localization of $(D_k)_g$, flat over it [lem-weil-pbc-localization-flat], hence flat over $R$ [lem-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map-comp] [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map]. By [lem-weil-pbc-annihilator-element-flat-base-change], $\mathrm{Ann}_{(D_k)_{\mathfrak q_k}}(\pi^i)=\mathrm{Ann}_R(\pi^i)(D_k)_{\mathfrak q_k}$ for $i=1,2$, and these agree since $\mathrm{Ann}_R(\pi)=\mathrm{Ann}_R(\pi^2)$. So $\pi y=0$, i.e. $p_{k',\ell}\mapsto0$ in $(D_k)_{\mathfrak q_k}$. Together with Step 15 all generators of $J_k$ (Step 10) vanish in $(D_k)_{\mathfrak q_k}$: $(J_k)_{\mathfrak q_k}=0$.

source.place: Smoothing Ring Maps, proof of Lemma 07CP (lemma-lifting), lines 1630-1645 ('Since we have assumed that Ann_R(pi) = Ann_R(pi^2) and since (D_k)_{q_k} is smooth hence flat over R ... p_{k',l} maps to zero as well, hence D_q = (D_k)_{q_k}')

lean.statement:
theorem popescu_lift_smooth (R : Type a) (Cbar : Type c)
    [CommRing R] [CommRing Cbar] [Algebra R Cbar] [IsNoetherianRing R] (π : R)
    [Algebra (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    [IsScalarTower R (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)) Cbar]
    (d : PopescuLiftPresentation R Cbar π) (hd : d.Prepared)
    (hAnnR : Module.annihilator R (Ideal.span ({π} : Set R)) =
      Module.annihilator R (Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R)))
    (c : Cbar →ₐ[R] (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
      Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (cmod : (Cbar ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R Cbar π} : Set Cbar)) →+*
      (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
        Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)))
    (hc : ∀ i : Fin d.n, c (d.ε (MvPolynomial.X i)) = Ideal.Quotient.mk _ (d.x i))
    (hcmod : cmod.comp (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) = c.toRingHom) :
    (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum d.liftingAlgebra,
      algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π ∉ q.asIdeal → IsSmoothAtPrime R q) ∧
    (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
        Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)),
      IsSmoothAtPrime (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R))
        (PrimeSpectrum.comap c.toRingHom q) →
      IsSmoothAtPrime R (PrimeSpectrum.comap (Ideal.Quotient.mk _) q)) ∧
    (∀ q : PrimeSpectrum (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
        Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra)),
      IsSmoothAtPrime (R ⧸ Ideal.span ({π ^ 2} : Set R))
        (PrimeSpectrum.comap c.toRingHom q) →
      @IsSmoothAtPrime (Cbar ⧸ Ideal.span ({algebraMap R Cbar π} : Set Cbar))
        (d.liftingAlgebra ⧸
          Ideal.span ({algebraMap R d.liftingAlgebra π} : Set d.liftingAlgebra))
        _ _ cmod.toAlgebra q)
